accepted_risks.dismissed_comment: Accepted vendor-compatibility risk: H3600P type-4 requires this exact SHA-256-derived key/IV; replacing it would break the format. Use is gated by --acknowledge-legacy-crypto. Secure local storage uses scrypt + AES-GCM via private-protect. See docs/config-cryptography.md.
compensating_controls: encrypted vendor output requires an explicit legacy-cryptography acknowledgement
authenticated local storage uses scrypt and AES-GCM instead of the vendor format
independent synthetic compatibility vectors pin the required protocol bytes
re_review_triggers: the vendor container derivation or encryption behavior changes
a supported authenticated vendor container becomes available

accepted_risks.dismissed_comment: TTN.10 firmware requires SHA-256(password + challenge) for device authentication. This is a transient challenge-response, not password storage; replacing it with a KDF would break interoperability. The compatibility exception is isolated and documented.
compensating_controls: web evidence requires an explicit local-HTTP authentication acknowledgement
the client makes one login attempt with no automatic retry
security guidance requires a trusted isolated LAN and a unique router password
re_review_triggers: the firmware adds HTTPS or a stronger authenticated login
